Guide: a new domain ​

bash
npm run new-domain -- bookings            # scaffolds domains/bookings from templates/

Then, in the build order (docs/PLAYBOOK.md):

  1. Tools — domains/bookings/mcp/server.ts. Implement reads (search_*, get_*, reference_data) and the triad: validate_booking_slots (write-free; returns problems, from_record, defaults), preview_booking, create_booking (refuses without confirmed:true and AGENT_ALLOW_WRITES === "true"; returns {created:true, entity_id, label?, entity_url?}). Keep internal_* for gateway-only work (uploads, attach). Wrap every handler with the reg() pattern from the example (auth context + trace context from _meta).
  2. Probe — domains/bookings/probe/probe.ts against the dev backend with --yes: one known-good create, then one field stripped at a time; tag, clean up, report. Fold the findings into the registry.
  3. Schema registry — schema/booking-schema.json: slots with sources, mandatory sets, ask sets, probe findings. Keep the validate tool reading it.
  4. Skill — skills/bookings/SKILL.md: routing, entry, the cascade, ask sets (one question per turn), validation after every change, what the runtime owns, never-rules. Deltas for variants ("all orchestrator rules apply; only X differs").
  5. Steps — steps/index.ts from stepHelpers (docs/guides/new-step.md); list their order in domain.json (step_order, or per type under types.<t>.steps).
  6. Manifest — domain.json: name, title, description (the router card), route hints, mcp, skills, shared skills, steps, slot labels, hidden slots, attested lists, entity names.
  7. Mock policy (optional but recommended) — mock/policy.ts with registerMockModel: the model's part of the journey as a state machine, so CI runs the whole domain with no key.
  8. Evals — evals/run-evals.ts from the template; the coverage checklist in the playbook.

Run npm run gateway (the domain is discovered at boot), walk the journey in the playground, then npm run gateway:evals & npm run evals.

With entity types ​

Declare types in the manifest (title, skill, tools, keywords, steps, flags) plus core_skills for the orchestrator and type_tool if you rename set_type. Only the in-play type's skill and tools reach the model.

Media ​

Implement internal_upload_media, internal_attach_media, internal_detach_media (optionally internal_arrange_media) and set AGENT_MEDIA_DOMAIN; the gateway does the rest.

Source: docs/guides/new-domain.md — edit it there; the site mirrors the repository.
